question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched control over the Chinese Communist Party, Politburo Standing Committee, and Central Military Commission underpins the 95% trader consensus that he remains in office through 2026. Term limits were abolished in 2018, enabling his third term and positioning him for a likely fourth at the 21st Party Congress expected in late 2027. Ongoing military and party purges have further centralized authority around loyalists, with no public signals of retirement, rivals, or succession planning emerging in recent months. Xi continues active diplomacy, economic planning, and PLA modernization efforts tied to the 2027 centenary. While sudden health developments, elite fractures, or unforeseen scandals could theoretically shift outcomes, recent institutional dominance and personnel patterns strongly underpin current market pricing.
